ezekiel.13.p1.b1.text: Your prophets, O Israel, are like foxes among the ruins. You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel …

ezekiel.13.p1.b3.text: when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built,

ezekiel.13.p1.b4.text: They see false visions and speak lying divinations.

ezekiel.13.p1.b5.text: it will fall. Rain will come in torrents, I will send hailstones plunging down, and a windstorm will burst forth.

ezekiel.13.p1.b6.text: Where is the whitewash with which you covered it?

ezekiel.13.p1.b7.text: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to My people who would listen …

ezekiel.13.p1.b8.text: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands … Then you will know that I am the LORD.
